openings.label: Battle of Kadesh
openings.line: At Kadesh, Ramesses II's Egyptians meet Muwatalli II's Hittites with thousands of chariots

openings.label: Battle of Marathon
openings.line: At Marathon, Athens and Plataea crush the Persian army sent to conquer Greece

openings.label: Battle of Zama
openings.line: At Zama, Scipio defeats Hannibal, and Carthage surrenders, ending the Second Punic War

openings.label: Assassination of Julius Caesar
openings.line: On the Ides of March, senators stab Julius Caesar to death at a meeting of the Senate

openings.label: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79
openings.line: Vesuvius erupts, burying Pompeii and Herculaneum under ash and pyroclastic surges

source.title: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD (Wikipedia)

openings.label: Battle of Hastings
openings.line: At Hastings, King Harold falls, and William of Normandy begins the conquest of England

openings.label: Siege of Baghdad
openings.line: Hülegü's Mongols besiege and sack Baghdad, ending the 500-year-old Abbasid Caliphate

openings.label: Fall of Constantinople
openings.line: Mehmed II besieges Constantinople, whose fall ends the Roman Empire after nearly 1,500 years

openings.label: Fall of Tenochtitlan
openings.line: Cortés and his Tlaxcaltec allies besiege Tenochtitlan, the Mexica capital, until it falls

openings.label: 1556 Shaanxi earthquake
openings.line: An earthquake shakes Shaanxi, collapsing the loess cave homes cut into its cliffs

openings.label: Battle of Sekigahara
openings.line: At Sekigahara, Tokugawa Ieyasu defeats Ishida Mitsunari, and the Tokugawa age begins

openings.label: Great Fire of London
openings.line: Fire breaks out in a Pudding Lane bakery and burns the City of London, Old St Paul's with it

openings.label: 1755 Lisbon earthquake
openings.line: On All Saints' Day, an earthquake, a tsunami and fire destroy most of Lisbon

openings.label: Battle of Plassey
openings.line: At Plassey, Robert Clive's East India Company army defeats the Nawab of Bengal

openings.label: United States Declaration of Independence
openings.line: In Philadelphia, the Second Continental Congress adopts the Declaration of Independence

openings.label: Lewis and Clark Expedition
openings.line: Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery sets out up the Missouri, bound for the Pacific

openings.label: Battle of Waterloo
openings.line: At Waterloo, Wellington and Blücher defeat Napoleon in his last battle

openings.label: Second voyage of HMS Beagle
openings.line: HMS Beagle reaches the Galápagos, where Darwin spends five weeks among giant tortoises

openings.label: Great Irish Famine
openings.line: Blight rots Ireland's potatoes; a million die in the famine, and a million more emigrate

openings.label: 1883 eruption of Krakatoa
openings.line: Krakatoa's explosion is heard 4,800 km away, and its tsunamis sweep Java and Sumatra

openings.label: Battle of Adwa
openings.line: At Adwa, Menelik II's army defeats Italy's invaders and secures Ethiopia's sovereignty

openings.label: 1906 San Francisco earthquake
openings.line: An earthquake on the San Andreas Fault shakes San Francisco, and fires burn for four days

openings.label: Sinking of the RMS Titanic
openings.line: On her maiden voyage, the Titanic sinks after striking an iceberg, and some 1,500 people die

openings.label: Attack on Pearl Harbor
openings.line: Japanese carrier planes strike the US fleet at Pearl Harbor, and America enters the war

openings.label: 1960 Valdivia earthquake
openings.line: The strongest earthquake ever recorded strikes Chile, and its tsunami crosses the Pacific
